body.heading: Draw the map
paragraphs: Draw your garden from above: the tree, the path, the flower pots. Pirates keep maps simple.
Draw a dotted line for the path and a big X where the treasure will hide.

body.heading: Follow the map
paragraphs: Your adult hides the treasure and gives you the map. Follow the dotted line step by step.
When you find the X, dig with your hands or just peek: treasure! Being a map reader feels powerful.

takeaway: X marks the spot, and the hunt is even better than the treasure.
materials: A small treasure to hide, like a painted stone
safetyNotes: Stay in the garden with your adult; an adult hides the treasure in a safe, easy place.
screenFreeExtension: Swap roles: draw a new map and let your adult be the treasure hunter.
